Voclone turns a few seconds of your voice into your own personal speech engine.

Record or upload a short reference clip, type whatever you want said, and Voclone generates natural-sounding speech in that voice in moments. No studio time, no audio editing software, no waiting on a freelancer.

Add a reference voice -> record yourself right in the app, or upload an existing clip
Type the script you want spoken

Shape the performance

Play, save, share
Preview every generation right in the app, save the audio to your device, or share it straight to Messages, Mail, or wherever you need it.

Pro (75,000 characters) or Studio (250,000 characters). Unused characters never expire, and if you buy again, they stack with whatever you have left.

Built for creators, podcasters, indie game developers, and anyone who needs a quick, natural voiceover without booking studio time.

Text to Speech is a modern TTS (text to speech) app, designed to helps people who’ve lost their voice communicate again in person and call.

Text to Speech has a familiar “chat-style” interface, so it feels just like you're texting somebody, helping you speak with SPEED and EFFICIENCY.

HOW IT WORKS
————————
That’s easy – just type, then press “speak”.  

More specifically, AI Text to Speech produces natural sounding speech from the words that you type. 

WHO THIS APP IS FOR
———————————
For people who rely on text to speech every day:
Designed to be stable, predictable, and easy to use when you need it most.
Clear playback, saved phrases, and consistent behavior you can depend on.

USES
———
- I lost my voice, and I use to struggle to communicate with others. But then I found this app which enables me to speak to people again!
- I was bored, but not anymore! This app is surprisingly addicting and makes a fun and entertaining way to have my phone say funny things.
- I can even use this text to speech app as a text reader. Just copy and paste online articles, books, etc., and this TTS reader will read it to me.

Features we DO have
——————————
- Free to download. No ads either.
- Natural text to speech with a clean, chat-style interface.
- 56 voices across 38 languages.
- Adjust volume, pitch, rate, and tone.
- Save frequent phrases for quick access.
- Background Audio implemented so the text reader can continue playing even when your phone is locked.
- Email Support. Don’t hesitate to email any questions or suggestions you have while using this app. We hope to make your experience as great as possible.

Advanced features
—————————
- Voice clone for a more personal voice.
- Lifelike avatar voices with expressive tone control.
- Save spoken audio for replay or sharing.
- Smart Reply suggestions to speed up typing.
- Call for Me: let the app make phone calls for you.

Features we (happily) DON’T have
————————————————
- NO Ads
    - Sorry, we know you love being blasted by popup ads every second like many text to speech apps, but this app doesn’t have any.
- EASY to Try
    - A free text to speech app for basic communication and text reading.

record.name: Memo AI - Voice Notes Taker
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
You're walking and ideas start coming. Stop and type each one? That's annoying. Keep walking and hope you remember? Good luck with that.

Memo fixes this. Hit record, talk, keep moving. The app handles the rest—transcription, formatting, even pulling out the important bits. No typing, no lost thoughts.

WORKS EVERYWHERE
Walking to work? Record. In a meeting? Put your phone on the table. At the doctor? Keep it in your pocket. Memo runs in the background and catches everything. You just talk.

ACTUALLY UNDERSTANDS YOU
The transcription is scary good. 12+ languages, and you can add your own words—client names, medical terms, that weird project acronym nobody can spell. It learns.

TURNS RAMBLING INTO REAL NOTES
Here's where it gets interesting. You talk for 20 minutes about three different things. Memo figures out what matters:
• The key points (not everything you said)
• Action items and deadlines
• Important dates you mentioned
• Formatted in clean markdown

CHAT WITH YOUR NOTES
"What did I say about the marketing budget?" Just ask. Memo searches your recordings, finds connections between notes, can even look things up online. The more you use it, the more context it has.

MAKE IT YOURS
Tell the AI how you like your notes. Short bullet points? Detailed summaries? Focus on action items? Set it once, or change it per recording. Your call.

ABOUT PRIVACY
Notes stay on your phone. Audio gets deleted after transcription (we don't want it either). Only the AI processing touches the cloud. We're not building a data business here.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• One-tap recording, works in background
• Transcription in 12+ languages
• Custom dictionary for tricky words
• Auto-formatting and structure
• Action items synced to Reminders
• AI chat that actually remembers
• Search that understands meaning, not just keywords
• Export to Markdown, PDF, NotePlan
• Offline mode when you need it

PEOPLE USE THIS FOR
• Quick thoughts on the go
• Meeting notes (finally, good ones)
• Lectures and classes
• Interviews and research
• Doctor appointments (so you don't forget what they said)
• Lawyer and accountant meetings
• Therapy sessions
• Journaling without the typing

Try it. Your future self will thank you.

Privacy Policy: https://noteplan.co/memo/privacy

Mimic – AI Voice Studio brings professional-quality speech generation and voice cloning directly to your device.

Powered entirely by on-device AI, Mimic lets you create natural-sounding voices without sending your data to the cloud. Your privacy is protected — all processing happens locally.

Key Features

● 16 Languages Supported – Generate speech in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.
● Built-in Voice Library – Choose from a wide selection of ready-to-use, pre-built voices.
● Voice Cloning – Clone your own voice or recreate unique voices easily and securely.
● Unlimited Speech Generation – No limits on how much text you can turn into speech.
● On-Device AI – Everything runs locally on your phone or tablet. Your data never leaves your device.
● High-Quality Output – Generate speech that is natural, expressive, and clear.

Privacy First

Unlike cloud-based apps, Mimic never uploads your recordings or text. All processing — from voice cloning to speech generation — is done on your device. This ensures full control over your data.

Who Is It For?

Mimic is designed for creators, learners, and everyday users who want powerful speech technology without complexity:

● Content Creators & Voiceovers – Generate voice tracks for videos, podcasts, and projects.
● Accessibility & Reading – Turn text into speech for easier access to books, articles, and messages.
● Language Learners – Practice pronunciation in 16 different languages.
● Personal Use – Create custom voices, clone your own, or just experiment with AI speech.

Why Choose Mimic?

● Works offline, no internet required.
● Protects your privacy with local processing.
● Provides professional-quality voices in multiple languages.
● Offers easy-to-use tools for both beginners and semi-professional users.

With Mimic – AI Voice Studio, you get the power of advanced AI voice generation in your pocket. Whether for fun, learning, or professional projects, Mimic makes it easy to bring text to life.

Memio lets you capture thoughts with your voice and instantly turns them into organized notes. Your spoken ideas become editable, rich text documents powered by an intelligent AI agent.

– Fully editable notes with voice or manual editing
– Smart agent that can read, edit, search, and organize your notes
– Web research capabilities for enhanced entries
– History timeline with full playback
– Undo any AI change at any time

Memio is more than a transcription tool. Every memo you record is processed by a dedicated AI agent that understands context, structure, and intent. Instead of raw speech-to-text, Memio converts your voice into clean, structured notes with headings, lists, and formatting that resemble a high-quality digital notebook.

Ask the agent to expand, improve, or edit any entry using only your voice. You can correct, refine, reorganize, or delete information without touching the keyboard. If you want to add new material, simply speak. Memio can also search the web when needed. Ask it to add a movie to your watchlist, include the latest rating, or look up the cast. The agent researches and updates your note automatically.

Every change is tracked. Use the History feature to replay previous voice memos and see exactly how the AI evolved your note over time. If the agent makes a change you don’t want, you can undo it with a tap.

Memio fits students, creators, founders, researchers, and anyone who thinks faster than they can type. Capture ideas during a commute, document meetings in seconds, log project updates on the go, or maintain personal journals and knowledge bases effortlessly. No more disorganized voice memos sitting in a list you never revisit. Memio turns thoughts into actionable, polished documents you can build on.

If you want a hands-free way to capture ideas, turn speech into structured content, and maintain organized notes without manual work, Memio makes it possible.
